environment: Bun 1.4.0; production and Storybook builds; deterministic project e2e runner with synthetic fixture data

newCases: Grouped declarations, repeated attempts, phase-scoped evidence, flow history and focus return
Namespaced/custom skills, no declarations, omissions, unfinished PR phase, GitHub asset and dark/narrow layout
Route changes and unavailable evidence in the sequence

acceptance.S1: pass: icon/name badges, real PR asset, readable namespace aliases and custom fallback
acceptance.S2: pass: grouped recorded phase order, retries, route changes, omissions and no-declaration phase
acceptance.S3: pass: attempt-scoped versus flow-wide evidence; missing evidence; close focus return
acceptance.S4: component pass; actual persisted Otis proof retained separately after deployment
acceptance.S5: pass: desktop/light and 390px/360px dark, final theme colors and no page overflow

review.intent: Matches the approved concept without changing capture or grades
review.quality: Self-reviewed: selection stores identity rather than stale records; stable phase keys; existing ordering and pairing; shared Button variant; no backend changes

editLoopFindings: Initial lint rejected styling a shared Button through an app class. Added a shared badge variant; final lint passes.
Initial strict check found browser test callbacks returning undefined. Made their JSON return values total; final strict check passes.
Initial dark screenshots caught controls during the existing color transition. Final checks wait for computed theme colors and account for sticky header height; settled screenshots retained.
limits: Order inside a group is unknown; reads and declarations do not prove skill execution
Supporting trace references describe a phase rather than uniquely attributing output to one skill
Synthetic component evidence does not certify autonomous agent delivery; live review is a separate observation
